name: Voxel Cone Tracing
aliases: Direct cone tracing in mesh shaders
Voxel Cone Tracing for Diffuse GI
Voxel Cone Tracing for Global Illumination
Voxel GI/AO Cone Tracing (Mesh Shader Path)
definition: A global illumination technique that traces cones from surface points into a 3D voxel texture to approximate indirect lighting, using pre-integrated cone traces to avoid expensive ray marching.
summary: Voxel Cone Tracing is a real-time global illumination technique that approximates indirect lighting by voxelizing scenes and sampling them via expanding cones, supporting glossy reflections natively.
